collections.title: Linear Algebra · Foundations
collections.summary: Elimination and bases; determinants, orthogonality and eigenvectors; dual spaces. Continue with exact operators, numerical matrix algorithms, or spectral computation.

collections.title: Matrix Operators · From Eigenvectors to Continuous Time
collections.summary: A four-lecture route from Cayley–Hamilton and the minimal polynomial to generalized eigenspaces, spectral projectors, and matrix exponentials.
assumed_background: Matrix multiplication, determinants, characteristic polynomials and simple eigenspaces. Basic derivatives and scalar exponentials are useful for the final lecture.

collections.title: Numerical Matrix Algorithms · From Elimination to Reliable Recovery
collections.summary: Construct pivoted LU, Householder QR, condition/error bounds and numerical rank, then exploit positive definiteness for Cholesky and conjugate gradients.
assumed_background: Basic elimination, matrix multiplication, vector length, inner products and least squares. Eigenvalues, singular values and quadratic derivatives support the later lectures.

collections.title: Numerical Spectral Theory · From Schur Form to Pseudospectra
collections.summary: Unitary Schur triangularization, the QR eigenvalue iteration, invariant-subspace projectors, and sensitivity of nonnormal eigenvalues via resolvents and pseudospectra.
assumed_background: Eigenvalues, matrix similarity, orthonormal bases, QR, singular values and matrix exponentials.
